Stefan Molyneux's episode 396 of the Joe Rogan Experience is an early debate from the show's wild west days. Molyneux, the online philosopher of liberty, met a young Rogan still testing how hard to push a guest. Their talk has the rough edges of the era.

He argues his core themes, reason and liberty against the claims of the state and the family, while Rogan probes for the seams. The episode pairs with his episode 436 visit as a two-part record of his early case. It is kept for the curious, as a sample of the ideas that moved through young podcasting.
